name: Vulcan Memory
description: Connects OpenClaw memory hooks and tools to Vulcan Memory Mesh through vulcan-host.

protoPath.description: Optional override for the bundled mcp_service.proto; a compatible vmm.proto must be in the same directory.

defaultUserId.description: Optional shared default VMM user id. When omitted, Vulcan falls back to persisted binding state and then user id 1.

defaultProjectId.description: Optional shared default VMM project id. When omitted, Vulcan falls back to persisted binding state and then project id 1.

agentProjects.description: Optional agentId -> projectId overrides. Persisted runtime changes can also update this binding layer outside openclaw.json.

enabled.description: Whether Vulcan memory tools and hooks are enabled.

autoRecall.description: Whether before_prompt_build should inject VMM recall context.

autoPostAction.description: Whether agent_end should write a clipped turn summary to VMM through vulcan-host. Default false.

recallTopK.description: Maximum VMM recall hits per automatic query.

implicitMemoryTurns.description: How many later committed turns one fresh automatic recall snapshot should stay eligible for hidden reuse. Default 5.

profileRefreshTurns.description: How many later closed committed turns should pass before the hidden profile bundle refreshes again. Set 0 to keep the first fetched bundle until scope changes. Default 5.
